description: Base network status and gas price: current block height and gas price (wei and gwei), live from a Base mainnet RPC node. Use it to check Base is moving, time an on-chain action or estimate gas before sending a transaction. Keyless, pay per call. No input needed. $0.02 per call. Returns: block_number, gas_price_wei, gas_price_gwei.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

name: hubvibe_chain_network
title: Base network state
